maria_cs: Heads-up — SableTech is greenlit for Dedicated next week but renewal is sensitive. Need a tight ops handoff: quota plan, autoscale policy, and a short smoke + load-test window. Can ops + infra confirm constraints?
jonah_infra: I can take infra ownership. Their committed GPU pool is 8xA10G for now. What qps/rt targets are we sizing for?
maria_cs: Sales says steady-state 120 rps (short requests) and spikes to 600 rps during peak syncs. P95 target <= 300ms for short requests. Renewal conversation tied to hitting SLOs first month.
prasanna_eng: For the model variant they're using (redwood-compact-7b-q4), token latency is ~8ms on A10G per token in our bench, but end-to-end depends on prompt length and batching. If we assume avg 40 tokens and batching ~8, that maps to ~320ms baseline. We should tune autoscaler to keep tail under 300ms.
oliver_sre: We'll need headroom. Recommend warm pool of 2 spare GPUs beyond their commit and a burst policy to 12 GPUs for 10m windows. Add circuit-breaker to fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.
kevin_account: Can we document this in the renewal playbook? Exec wants clear metrics to show to SableTech. Also we need enablement — a 30m runbook walk-through with their platform team.
jonah_infra: Agree. Proposed autoscale policy: min_replicas=8, target_cpu=60, target_gpu_util=70, max_replicas=12, cooldown=3m. Also enable KV prefix caching for common prompts.
prasanna_eng: KV caching helps a lot for sessioned chat — can save ~25% token work. I'll update the model profile and add quantization fallback (q3 -> q4) if mem pressure happens.
maria_cs: Nice. For load tests, ops: what dates work  — preferrably during their maintenance window Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. SableTech ok with that.
j onah_infra: Wed 02:30 UTC works. We'll run a stepped load test: 100rps for 10m, 300rps for 15m, ramp to 600rps for 10m, cooldown. Use our staging-to-prod mirroring to avoid neighbor blast.
oliver_sre: I'll own the monitoring runbook. We'll watch: GPU_util, queue_length, 99th_latency, model_fallback_count, error_rate. I'll add alert thresholds: 99th_latency > 1s or error_rate > 1% -> page ENG.
prasanna_eng: Load test command for reference (vegeta):
```
echo "GET https://prod.redwood/api/generate" | vegeta attack -duration=10m -rate=300 -connections=500 | vegeta report
```
jonah_infra: Also add a quick smoke script to validate KV caches + routing:
```
export CUSTOMER=SableTech
./scripts/smoke_small_prompts.sh --customer $CUSTOMER --warm=1000
```
deploybot: deploy successful: dedicated-configs/sabletech/autoscale v1.2 applied by jonah_infra at 2026-03-01T14:12:09Z :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Perfect — can someone create the calendar invite for Wed 02:30 UTC load-run and include SableTech ops + our runbook link? I'll handle the renewal docs after the test.
kevin_account: I'll create the invite and attach the renewal playbook draft. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/sabletech-renewal-playbook
jonah_infra: I'll also stage the KB and share SSH keys with SableTech read-only for traces. Note: we should pre-warm the KV cache immediately before load by replaying 2k sample prompts.
prasanna_eng: I'll prepare a short checklist for canary fallbacks: model-hierarchy, quantization thresholds, and forced-cache-warm commands.
oliver_sre: After test, I'll produce a short postmortem-lite scoreboard: latency by percentile, errors, fallback events, cost delta. That will feed the renewal packet.
maria_cs: OK action items: jonah (infra) — run load test Wed 02:30 UTC, pre-warm KV 2k prompts; oliver (SRE) — monitoring & alerts, post-test scoreboard; prasanna (eng) — update model profile & fallback checklist; kevin (acct) — calendar + renewal draft; maria — capture customer notes and lead renewal call.
maria_cs: Thanks team. If we hit the SLOs first 72h post-rollout, renewal looks healthy. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
